Definition: from G4862 and G3444; jointly formed, i.e. (figuratively) similar:--conformed to, fashioned like unto.
BiblicalUsage: God predestined His people to be conformed to the image of His Son, that He might be the firstborn among many brethren, and Paul says Christ will change our lowly body that it may be fashioned like His glorious body. The shape God is making of us is the shape of Jesus, and the work is finished when we look like Him.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God is shaping me into the likeness of His Son, and I hold that nothing less than Christ's own shape is His goal for me.
